doubts.claim_under_doubt: the head is always pinned to the audited commit
doubts.summary: The release guard ignores the --match-head-commit value and judges only local HEAD; an unpinned or wrongly pinned gh pr merge line is allowed while HEAD is the release. Pinning is promised by SKILL prose, not enforced by the guard.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the guard parses every gh pr merge form
doubts.summary: -A (short --author-email) is not a value option, so its value is read as the PR target and the action is skipped.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: repo merge settings decide the accepted method
doubts.summary: Branch rules (linear history, rulesets, merge queue) can refuse --merge or queue it; a merge queue exits 0 before merging.
SKILL Step 7 says every refusal stops the release, while *_unknown details say run merge-ready again.

summary: 1 medium, 3 low; merge-ready itself cannot answer ok for unaudited code, refusals write nothing, base_moved and base_state_unknown never cross.
